limitations: Gene-level calls only (no variant, position or allele frequency).

capabilities.population: primary tumors with copy-number calls
limitations: GISTIC thresholds are estimates; +1/-1 are low-level and noisy.
Copy number is not expression: amplification does not prove the gene is overexpressed.

capabilities.population: primary tumors with RPPA data
limitations: Relative, normalized levels: 'higher in group A than B' is checkable; absolute amounts are not.
Only 131 antibodies; many proteins are not measured.

capabilities.population: primary tumors with survival rows
limitations: Follow-up length varies: raw event percentages are not survival probabilities.
